answer_1.quote: This task is related to (i) learning material generation, (ii) near-synonyms disambiguation, and (iii) natural language inference.
datasets: Dataset of helpful example sentences for ESL learners

answer_2.quote: The average accuracy of EMLA and CMLA is 0.90 and 0.86

answer_4.quote: In this learner study, a total of 29 Chinese-speaking college freshmen majored in English were recruited.
answer_4.guideline: Students take pre-test and post-test with fill-in-the-blank questions; improvement in scores is measured. They also rate the difficulty of the examples.
